entities.summary: Algernon Darius Crumpler is an American former professional football player who was a tight end in the National Football League (NFL) for ten seasons. He was selected by the Atlanta Falcons in the second round of the 2001 NFL draft. Crumpler also played for the Tennessee Titans and New England Patriots. He is a four-time Pro Bowl selection. He played college football for North Carolina.
